chat.greeting:
This is the farm chat, where you, the assistant and the helpers talk. Tell me something to do, such as "have the tester run the tests".

Once helpers arrive, write a name like @w1 to call one directly; each ticket has its own thread under it.

sow.homeless: This farm belongs to no repo
sow.toMap: To plant, enter a repo's farm first: open Repos and pick a repository.
sow.noRepos: No repos in the workbench yet: make one on the Repos page first.
sow.jobHint: What to do, and what counts as done
sow.how: Start: the assistant hands this to a helper, who starts in {repo} at once. Draft: a helper reads the code and writes it up as a ticket for you to look over before starting.

drops.1: Leave the tests alone for now
drops.3: Add a test while at it

water.working: It is working: it hears this before its next step.
water.idle: It is not working: this has it work another round.
water.thread: This is kept in its ticket thread, with its replies.
water.moved: The ticket's status changed: go back to the plot and see what it asks of you.
